]

    splane axis,
    axis line style={opacity=0.4},          % more transparent axis lines
    tick style={opacity=0.4},                % match tick transparency
    xmin=-6, xmax=6,
    ymin=-6, ymax=6,
    xtick={-6,-4,-2,0,2,4,6},
    ytick={-6,-4,-2,0,2,4,6},
    clip mode=individual,                    % keep markers from being clipped
]

    % Shaded Unstable Right-Half Plane (RHP)
